findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent non-development calls that observe an empty cache all proceed to acquire the write lock. After the first call populates the cache, each queued call still reloads and parses the manifest while holding the exclusive lock instead of using the cached result. A burst of requests at startup therefore causes repeated, serialized file reads and blocks otherwise cacheable requests behind those reloads. Recheck entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring the write lock and return it when populated outside development mode.
